method.parse: Parse outer CLI invocation JSON, then parse its stdout as JSON; inspect only axTree descendants.
method.normalization: Uppercase then remove all characters except ASCII A-Z and 0-9.
method.excluded: CLI command arguments, filenames, paths, stdout wrapper prose, targetExecutable, screenshots and currentText state outside the AX tree are not searched.
method.countMeaning: Occurrence counts are within returned text attributes; repeated content across attributes/nodes is not an independent leak trial.
method.scope: No new AX call was made. Only already saved synthetic NativeControlDemo AX data were read.

supplementalMarkers.committedChineseLiteral_你好: Exact literal substring in AX text attributes; ASCII normalization is not used for Chinese.

method.contextBoundary: Observation before/after currentText and active/window state are metadata for validity only, excluded from AX marker matching.
